pages.text: Right-click a lit bonfire and choose $(l)Level Up$() from its menu. Press $(l)+$() beside a stat to raise it, paying in $(l)experience levels$(). The price rises with your $(l)Soul Level$(), shown under your name and at the top of the page.

$(l)Vigor$(): health. $(l)Endurance$(): stamina. $(l)Strength$(): melee damage. $(l)Dexterity$(): attack speed. $(l)Attunement$(): mana. $(l)Intelligence$(): spell power. Twenty points each, at most.$(br2)Experience also pays for enchanting and the anvil. Choose.
